kit.ir.help.title: Help
kit.ir.help.intro: This page is an interactive report. Every change you make is applied on the server to all matching rows, not only to the rows on screen.
kit.ir.help.search.title: Search
kit.ir.help.search.body: Pick All Columns or one text column, type the text, then press Go or Enter. The text becomes a search chip and the search box is cleared.
kit.ir.help.actions.title: Actions menu
kit.ir.help.actions.body: Every report feature is in the Actions menu: Columns, Filter, Data (Sort, Aggregate), Format (Control Break, Highlight, Rows Per Page), Report (Save, Reset, Delete), Download and Help.
kit.ir.help.header.title: Column header menu
kit.ir.help.header.body: Click a column title to sort it ascending or descending, hide it, set it as a control break, or look through its unique values (the first 500).
kit.ir.help.chips.title: Report settings (chips)
kit.ir.help.chips.body: Each filter, control break, highlight and aggregate shows as a chip. Its checkbox switches it off without deleting it, clicking its text reopens the dialog with its values, and ✕ deletes it.
kit.ir.help.columns.title: Columns
kit.ir.help.columns.body: Move columns between Do Not Display and Display in Report, then order the displayed ones with Top, Up, Down and Bottom.
kit.ir.help.filter.title: Filter
kit.ir.help.filter.body: Filter a column with the operators its type allows. Between takes two values, in and not in take many (separated with ; for numbers and , for text), and last and next take a number plus a unit. The Pick value button lists the values that already exist in that column.
kit.ir.help.sort.title: Sort
kit.ir.help.sort.body: Order the report by up to six columns; each one chooses a direction and where NULL values go.
kit.ir.help.break.title: Control Break
kit.ir.help.break.body: Group the rows by up to six columns. A break column stops being a table column and its value is printed above each group.
kit.ir.help.highlight.title: Highlight
kit.ir.help.highlight.body: Colour a whole row or a single cell when a condition matches. The first enabled highlight in sequence order wins, and the colours come from the theme palette.
kit.ir.help.aggregate.title: Aggregate
kit.ir.help.aggregate.body: Add sums, averages, counts, minimums or maximums per column; Sum and Average are offered for numeric columns only. Totals appear under each group and at the end of the table.
kit.ir.help.rows.title: Rows Per Page
kit.ir.help.rows.body: Choose how many rows one page shows, from 5 up to 1000.
kit.ir.help.save.title: Save, reset and delete a report
kit.ir.help.save.body: Save Report stores the current settings under a name. With the publish permission you can also make the report public or save it as the default settings for everyone. Reset restores the default settings, and Delete removes a saved report.
kit.ir.help.download.title: Download
kit.ir.help.download.body: Export the current report as CSV. Semicolon is the default separator for Indonesian so Excel opens it with one field per column.
kit.ir.help.keyboard.title: Keyboard and persistence
kit.ir.help.keyboard.body: Every menu opens with Enter or Space and closes with Escape, and Escape cancels a dialog. Unsaved settings are kept for the session, so coming back from an edit page shows the same report.
